title: Cinema Sunday: Night at the Museum
seo_title: Cinema Sunday: Night at the Museum at Gillioz Theatre
description: This is a free screening of Night at the Museum, in which night guard Larry Daley finds the Natural History Museum's animals coming to life after closing because of an Egyptian curse. Seating is general admission, and reservations are required by phone at 417-863-9491 or in person; reserved tickets must be redeemed at least 15 minutes before showtime. It takes place Sunday, February 21, 2027 at 2:00 PM at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central E., Springfield, MO.
